title: An Essay towards solving a Problem in the Doctrine of Chances
version: Philosophical Transactions 53 (volume dated 1763), pp. 370–418, scanned journal article; DOI 10.1098/rstl.1763.0053

passages.note: Heading identifies Bayes and Price’s communication to John Canton; printed marginal note dates reading 23 December 1763. Price reports the unknown-probability problem and equal chance for equal prior intervals, while noting Bayes considered the postulate debatable.
